gen-gf-lisu-bosa-manrope: Literary serifs up top in Lisu Bosa, then a wire-thin monoline sans. Manrope keeps copy moving with open mouths and a one-width pen line under those serifs.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-switzer: Switzer draws tubular, wire-like letters under Lisu Bosa, with c tips that never creep toward touching. A slightly reduced size still holds for that Swiss plain sans.
gen-gf-liter-fs-karma: Liter dominates the line with stencil-cut, rounded, unvarying weight. Karma then stays classic through dense copy, terminals stopping short of each stem, a modest thick-thin throughout.
gen-gf-magra-fs-erode: Big counters in a hefty lowercase mark Magra, a modern sans punch over editorial, dignified Erode. The copy still holds if the point size drops a notch.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-fs-merriweathe: Precise Major Mono Display holds one width, body height nearly matching the caps. And Merriweather Sans stays sturdy through copy, with an e that opens clearly right.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-satoshi: Satoshi reads approachable under Major Mono Display, a soaring x-height and a wide-open e. Satoshi keeps copy moving on one-width strokes, a plain sans under that structured mono grid.
gen-gf-manuale-satoshi: Lowercase nearly matching the caps marks Manuale, a soft-pencil thick-thin up top. And Satoshi keeps copy moving on one-width strokes and a wide-open e, a plain sans under that literary serif.
gen-gf-manuale-work-sans: A soft-pencil thick-thin and near-cap lowercase mark literary Manuale. Work Sans then keeps copy moving on a raised waist, joins matching the strokes, a contemporary sans-serif.
gen-gf-marcellus-sc-work-sans: Work Sans reads contemporary, joins matching the strokes, a raised waist under Marcellus SC. And a slightly reduced size still holds for that drafting-pen line under the soft brush serif.
gen-gf-markazi-text-archivo: Markazi Text crowds its letters, a bookish serif with a mellow range of stroke weights throughout. Archivo leaves Markazi Text to a few large words, not a heading paragraph.
gen-gf-markazi-text-fs-public-sans: Crowded bookish serifs over a hefty plain sans: Markazi Text leads. Public Sans keeps copy moving with broad mouths on the rounds and a trustworthy line.
gen-gf-markazi-text-fs-supreme: Supreme is a crisp sans under crowded Markazi Text. Supreme keeps copy moving as a heavy middle strip, letters held open, under that bookish mellow thick-thin.
gen-gf-markazi-text-switzer: Bookish crowding against Swiss tubing: Markazi Text over Switzer, slight thick-thin against a line that never changes direction. A slightly reduced size still holds for that constant-width Swiss line.
gen-gf-markazi-text-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern, c tips held apart, joins matching the strokes under Markazi Text. And it keeps copy moving on a line that never varies, against that crowded mellow serif.
gen-gf-martel-sans-fs-erode: Erode reads editorial, a gentle ebb of weight and a broad g, under Martel Sans. And Martel Sans wants a few large words, short caps beside hefty small letters.
